Welcome to EVERFI K-12's YouTube Channel

Together with thousands of teachers in the EVERFI from Blackbaud community, we're elevating the importance of whole-child education for all. Whether you're here to learn more about EVERFI K-12's robust catalog of free digital learning resources (spanning Financial Education, Health & Wellness, Workforce Readiness, STEM & History lessons) or connecting with our educator stories, you'll leave with inspiration and best practices to take back to your classroom. 

Be sure to connect with the entire EVERFI K-12 community on Facebook, X, TikTok, Pinterest, and Instagram pages, and most importantly don't forget to subscribe to this channel so you don't miss a thing!
